subject: Change 1.3.0-RC1 to 1.3.0 in command JSON files (#1730)
reason: The change edits only version strings ("1.3.0-RC1" -> "1.3.0") in the history and module_since fields of src/commands/ft.*.json. These JSON files are documentation metadata: no build rule, cmake script, or source file in valkey-search references or embeds them, and the module registers its commands in C++ without reading them. The compiled module binary is identical in behavior at the change and at its parent, so no command reply, replication path, or persistence path can differ; a compared sequence would find no difference and any expect_difference marker would fail as unreached. No scenario
